title: Audit Log (immutable)
summary: Legal-grade immutable audit trail — append-only table with a denormalized actor snapshot (actorRole/actorLabel captured at write time), before/after jsonb, and targetLabel. Ships a fire-and-forget log() helper that records the real actor even for act-on-behalf-of.

postInstall.description: Re-export the audit-log schema from the Drizzle barrel so drizzle-kit picks up the table: add `export * from "./audit-log/schema"` to lib/schema/index.ts (or import it into lib/schema.ts). Without this, db:generate will not emit a migration for audit_log_entries.
Generate the Drizzle migration for the audit_log_entries table.
Apply the migration to your database.

Call log({ action, targetType, targetId, before, after }) from your mutations after they succeed. Pairs naturally with lib/define-action.ts — return the entry as the handler's `audit` field, or call log() directly.
